quarterly_data.quarter: TTM Technologies press release: TTM Technologies, Inc. Agrees to Acquire MKS Inc.'s Ophir (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TTM entered into a definitive agreement (announced October 19, 2026) to acquire the Ophir Optics business from MKS Inc. in an all-cash transaction; Ophir Optics is an Israel and Romania-based manufacturer of high-precision infrared thermal imaging and laser optics solutions, serving defense, security and industrial applications. The deal excludes MKS's Ophir Instruments laser characterization business and the Ophir brand. Closing is expected in the second quarter of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions including certain regulatory approvals and certain governmental consents and permits. CEO Edwin Roks: the acquisition is another step in TTM's long-term growth strategy, expanding its portfolio with mission-critical optical solutions for land, air, maritime and unmanned platforms and its industrial portfolio and adding advanced optics to provide systems solutions to its defense and industrial customers, which he expects to help it benefit from the growing need for surveillance and the increasing use of laser applications by the industrial base.
quarterly_data.figure: Ophir Optics acquisition from MKS; closing expected in the second quarter of 2027
